The M13 gate ties to the same bias line as M12's gate, so both share one net, and the crossing at E is just a hop with no connection.

I'm changing A1 to a fully differential amp, with InP on net3, InN on net1, and the outputs on net4 and net7. A2 gets the same treatment with its own pins. I'm also setting M4's drain to net13 and merging nets 22 and 23.
